heading_contract.reason: Existing along-trajectory mode holds previous yaw inside 2 m hover region; prevents unplanned auto heading recapture. No outer-loop code or transform changes. v1 observations retained separately; all v2 PID/ESTA references reacquired.

excitation.publisher: existing mc_att_control only; position/attitude/thrust source unchanged
excitation.yaw_frame: world-z mapped by q.inverse().dcm_z() to body rates, original attitude quaternion law retained

analysis.ratio: Each ESTA/ISTA R/P/Y RMSE <=1.25 times same-scene three PID median; no noise floor or omitted windows.
analysis.yaw_command_bound: New yaw acceptance bound is normalized physical maximum 1; existing M05 PID has liftoff peaks up to .698. ESTA internal bound remains .15 on every selected axis. R/P previous limits unchanged.
analysis.staging: ISTA AXES=1 on M04 scene against frozen PID, then AXES=3 on M05 scene against frozen PID; only after those pass, AXES=7 on this M06 v2 scene. Final PID/ESTA/ISTA three runs each on same binary; fixed 1.25 RMSE threshold, all axes and all windows. Candidate01 RP failed; candidate02 lowers only ISTA pitch lambda1 to 2.0. ESTA retains frozen 2.4. This is not an equal-gain discretization-only comparison.
analysis.fault_policy: No automatic PID takeover. Latch and suppress publication; host SITL abort. Disarm reset before mode changes.
analysis.scope: Small rate excitation with original attitude loop active, not large-heading mission or hardware certification
